Get EASL Team Box Score

Source: R/easl.R
easl_team_box.Rd

Team totals of a finished game, one row per team, with the opponent's totals as *_against columns.

Endpoint: GET https://easl.joshricha.com/api/v1/matches/{fixture_id}/teamstats

Usage

easl_team_box(fixture_id)

Arguments

fixture_id

(required) DataCore fixture (game) UUID v1, e.g. '10af8fd4-106e-11f1-960b-5798087c7aa3' (the 2025-26 EASL Championship): the 'id' of easl_schedule rows. Only finished (CONFIRMED) games are served; a malformed id is hoopR_bad_request.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Team totals of a finished game, one row per team, with the opponent's totals as *_against columns. An empty answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py easl_team_box):

col_nametypedescription
fixture_idcharacterfixtureId: DataCore fixture (game) UUID v1 (key space: EASL games; the {fixtureId} of every /matches route).
team_idcharacterDataCore team (entity) UUID v1 (the wire's entityId).
team_namecharacterDisplay name. Despite the field name this is the English / Latin-script name used on the league site.
team_name_nativecharacterAlternative name: the native-script name of some Japanese clubs (for example the Japanese-script name of Utsunomiya Brex), blank for most clubs; for players it usually equals nameFullLocal. Despite the field name it is not always Latin script. Null on some rows.
assistsintegerAssists: passes that directly lead to a made field goal. Team total for the game.
assists_againstintegerOpponent's figure in the same games: assists: passes that directly lead to a made field goal. Team total for the game. Absent on some rows.
assists_defensiveintegerDefensive assists (DataCore column; meaning unverified). Team total for the game.
assists_turnover_ratiodoubleAssists divided by turnovers (a ratio, not a percentage). Team total for the game.
biggest_leadintegerLargest lead the team held during the game, in points. A season total sums the per-game maxima. Team total for the game.
biggest_scoring_runintegerLongest unanswered scoring run of the team, in points. A season total sums the per-game maxima. Team total for the game.
blocksintegerShots blocked (made by this player or team). Team total for the game.
blocks_receivedintegerThe team's or player's own shots that were blocked by an opponent. Team total for the game.
dunksintegerDunks made. Team total for the game.
efficiencyintegerNBA-style efficiency: points + rebounds + assists + steals + blocks - missed field goals - missed free throws - turnovers (verified on all 2,143 played player-games). Team total for the game.
efficiency_customintegerCustom efficiency slot (DataCore column; meaning unverified). Team total for the game.
field_goals_attemptedintegerField goals attempted (2- and 3-point shots; free throws excluded). Team total for the game.
field_goals_attempted_againstintegerOpponent's figure in the same games: field goals attempted (2- and 3-point shots; free throws excluded). Team total for the game. Absent on some rows.
field_goals_effective_percentagedoubleEffective field-goal percentage on a 0-100 scale: (FGM + 0.5 x 3PM) / FGA x 100; can exceed 100 on small samples. Team total for the game.
field_goals_madeintegerField goals made (2- and 3-point shots). Team total for the game.
field_goals_made_againstintegerOpponent's figure in the same games: field goals made (2- and 3-point shots). Team total for the game. Absent on some rows.
field_goals_percentagedoubleField-goal percentage on a 0-100 scale (made / attempted x 100). Team total for the game.
field_goals_percentage_againstdoubleOpponent's figure in the same games: field-goal percentage on a 0-100 scale (made / attempted x 100). Team total for the game. Absent on some rows.
fouls_bench_technicalintegerTechnical fouls called on the bench (not a player). Team total for the game.
fouls_coach_disqualifyingintegerDisqualifying fouls on the coach. Team total for the game.
fouls_coach_technicalintegerTechnical fouls on the coach. Team total for the game.
fouls_disqualifyingintegerDisqualifying fouls. Team total for the game.
fouls_disruptiveintegerDisruptive fouls (DataCore column; filled from 2026-27). Team total for the game. Absent on some rows.
fouls_drawnintegerFouls drawn (committed against this player or team by an opponent). Team total for the game.
fouls_flagrantintegerFlagrant fouls (DataCore column; filled from 2026-27). Team total for the game. Absent on some rows.
fouls_offensiveintegerOffensive fouls committed. Counted separately from foulsPersonal. Team total for the game.
fouls_personalintegerPersonal fouls committed (offensive, technical and unsportsmanlike fouls are separate columns). Team total for the game.
fouls_personal_againstintegerOpponent's figure in the same games: personal fouls committed (offensive, technical and unsportsmanlike fouls are separate columns). Team total for the game. Absent on some rows.

fouls_technical_cat1integerTechnical fouls of category 1 (DataCore column; filled from 2026-27). Team total for the game. Absent on some rows.
fouls_technical_cat2integerTechnical fouls of category 2 (DataCore column; filled from 2026-27). Team total for the game. Absent on some rows.
fouls_totalintegerFouls charged in total: personal + technical + unsportsmanlike + offensive (matches 2,142 of 2,143 played player-games; the exception is unexplained). Team total for the game.
fouls_unsportsmanlikeintegerUnsportsmanlike fouls committed. Team total for the game.
free_throws_attemptedintegerFree throws attempted. Team total for the game.

free_throws_percentage_againstdoubleOpponent's figure in the same games: free-throw percentage on a 0-100 scale. Team total for the game. Absent on some rows.
index_of_successintegerIndex of success: efficiency + fouls drawn - personal fouls - technical fouls - blocks received (verified on all 2,143 played player-games). It differs from pir only in which fouls it subtracts. Team total for the game.
lead_changesintegerTimes the lead changed hands during the game (a season total sums the games). Team total for the game.
minutescharacterPlaying time as an ISO 8601 duration PT{m}M{s}S with the minutes NOT wrapped at 60 (PT27M53S; a team's is the sum of its players', PT200M for a 40-minute game, PT250M with one overtime). Team total for the game.
pirintegerPerformance index rating: efficiency + fouls drawn - total fouls - blocks received (verified on all 2,143 played player-games). Team total for the game.

Details

  • WARNING: UNOFFICIAL THIRD-PARTY INTERMEDIARY. These wrappers read easl.joshricha.com/api/v1, an Express server run by an individual. It is not EASL's and not Sportradar's: it mirrors Sportradar DataCore (organisation b1e0z) into SQLite and serves it keyless, and it can change or vanish without notice. Its routes, field names (steak, facebook_username) and sync freshness are the proxy author's. A first-party DataCore feed needs credentials this package does not have. The host serves no robots.txt (404) and states no terms; the runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included, and honours Retry-After. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Seasons are END years (2026 = EASL 25-26). The server's season key is the START year; the runtime reads the season list, maps the END year to the DataCore seasonId and defaults to the ACTIVE season. Four editions exist (2023-24 to 2026-27). The server defaults to the active season on /matches, /standings and /leaders; the runtime always sends the resolved seasonId. A season is two calendar years: group by season_id, not by the year of the tip-off.

  • Finished games only: the game routes first read the fixture and refuse (hoopR_asset_fetch) one that is not CONFIRMED with two scores, a box score whose player points do not add up to the score (the server serves one-team, four-row boxes for some games), a play-by-play that does not end on the final score in its highest period (4 or more, and the last period of the period table), and team totals that disagree with the score. For the ACTIVE season's fixture lists the runtime reads /health: a server clock more than a day from yours, or a game still SCHEDULED more than a day after its tip-off, means the mirror has stalled (hoopR_asset_fetch). That proves the mirror kept up with the games played, not that a game is final upstream.

  • Ids: every DataCore id is a UUID v1 string. team_id = entityId, player_id = personId; fixture_number (YYSSNNN) is null on every 2023-24 fixture; *_row_id columns are the sync server's own integers, not DataCore ids. The fixture's competitors come in arbitrary order: read home_* / away_*, which the parsers take from isHome.

  • No shot x/y, no game clock and no lineups exist on this server. The play-by-play text always says 'missed' for field goals and 'Free throw K of M made' for free throws, made or not: use points_scored (the change of the event team's running score), which lags on a minority of events. 301 of 2,444 sampled box rows are players who did not play (null minutes and counting stats; points are 0); player_box.played tells them apart. easl_player_stats ignores a season filter: it is the career line over every season. Names: nameFullLocal is the English display name and nameFullLatin the native-script name, so the columns are name and name_native.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, an empty list or leaders object, a team or player without games), hoopR_bad_request (a malformed id, or a season that is not one of the server's END years, raised before the request that would use it) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other failure: any non-2xx, including the server's HTTP 400 / 422 and the HTTP 500 it answers for an unknown fixture, which is not retried; an error envelope; a game that is not finished or whose box score or play-by-play is incomplete; a stalled sync on the active season; a body for another game, season, team or player than the one asked for). Wrappers raise; they never warn and return an empty frame.

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(easl_team_box(fixture_id = "10af8fd4-106e-11f1-960b-5798087c7aa3"))
#> ── EASL Team Box Score from easl.joshricha.com ────────────────── hoopR 3.2.0 ──

#> 2 10af8fd4-106e-11f1… f17004… Taoyuan … Taoyuan Pauian …      24              19
#> # ℹ 99 more variables: assists_defensive <int>, assists_turnover_ratio <dbl>,
#> #   biggest_lead <int>, biggest_scoring_run <int>, blocks <int>,
#> #   blocks_received <int>, dunks <int>, efficiency <int>,
